topic.title: Organization AI Usage Page
topic.shortdesc: Organization administrators can use the AI Usage page to set monthly AI credit limits and review current-month AI credit usage.

body.p: The AI Usage page in enables organization administrators to set monthly AI credit limits and review AI credit usage for the current calendar month.

section.title: Accessing the AI Usage Page
section.p: Only users with the Organization Administrator role can access the AI Usage page.

ol.li: Click your user profile name in the top-right corner of the interface.
Select Manage organization from the drop-down menu.
In the organization administration area, click AI Usage in the left navigation panel.

section.note: If you do not see Manage organization in your user menu, you do not have the Organization Administrator role in the organization.

section.title: Page Layout
section.p: The AI Usage page has two sections:

dd.p: This section shows the organization's monthly AI credit limit and the default monthly limits for Authors and Contributors.
To edit the organization's monthly spending limit, click the edit button () in the Organization credits / month box.
To edit the monthly spending limit for a platform user role (Author or Contributor), click the edit button () next to the particular role in the Default spending limit per role box.

dlentry.dd: This section shows the current-month AI credit usage for each active Author and Contributor. You can also set an optional custom monthly spending limit for an individual user by clicking the edit button () to the far-right of the user's row.

p.note: AI usage generated by a translation job is attributed to the user who started the job, and that user's AI usage limits apply.

section.title: How Monthly AI Credit Limits Work
section.p: AI credit usage is based on actual AI calls made during the current calendar month. Usage resets automatically at the start of the next month.
A value of No limit means that no monthly limit is set at that level. Existing organizations have no monthly limits until an administrator sets a value.
When you set a limit, it must be greater than zero.
The prepaid organization AI credit wallet still applies. Users consume credits from the wallet until it is empty, even if no monthly limit is set.

section.title: Effective Monthly Limit for a User
section.p: A user's effective monthly limit is determined as follows:

ul.li: If the user has a custom monthly limit, that limit applies.
Otherwise, the default limit for the user's platform role applies: Author or Contributor.

section.p: Changing a role's default limit does not change the custom limits of users in that role. A custom limit remains in effect until an administrator removes it.
Changing a user's role does not remove the user's custom limit. The custom limit continues to apply. If an administrator later removes it, the default limit for the user's current role applies.

p.note: Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) are not listed on the AI Usage page and do not have a per-user monthly limit. Unattributed AI calls, such as task digest summaries, also do not use a per-user limit.

section.title: Organization and Per-User Limits
section.p: Per-user limits, including default and custom limits, are independent of the organization's monthly limit. The combined default and custom limits can exceed the organization monthly limit. They do not need to add up to that limit.
An AI call is allowed only when none of the applicable limits has already been reached. The system checks limits in this order:

ol.li: The user's monthly limit, if one applies, either custom or role default.
The organization's monthly limit, if one is set.
The prepaid wallet, which must have a positive credit balance.
